questions.q: Who is the serpent in Genesis 3?
choices: One of the beasts of the field Adam named
An angel of the Most High
questions.explain: This is not a literal snake; another word for serpent is deceiver, and serpents do not speak. Satan transforms himself (2 Corinthians 11:14).

questions.q: What was the fruit Eve ate?
choices: The fruit of the tree of life
questions.explain: The fruit she ate was the lies; the fruit of lies is eaten (Hosea 10:13).

questions.q: What does the nakedness of Adam and Eve represent (Genesis 3:7)?
questions.explain: They were not literally naked; nakedness represents sin. Jerusalem sinned and her nakedness was seen (Lamentations 1:8).

questions.q: In the prophecy of Genesis 3:15, who is the woman?
questions.explain: It is not talking about the serpent and Eve; the woman is the nation of Israel. Revelation 12 explains this verse.

questions.q: What did the coats of skins in Genesis 3:21 begin?
choices: Animal sacrifice to cover sin, a lamb that also represents Christ
The making of clothing for trade
questions.explain: This is where the Most High ordained the sacrificial law. The lamb slain represents Christ, slain from the foundation of the world (Revelation 13:8).
